A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Before we
get started.

Still have something on your mind?
Try our demo assistant or send an enquiry.

Where do I start with solar?+

Start with your electricity usage, the appliances you want to run and your available roof space. A site assessment helps determine suitable panels, inverter capacity and battery storage.

Can I start with backup power only?+

Yes. An inverter and battery system can support selected essentials. Ask about a system designed to accommodate solar panels later.

What size system do I need?+

System size depends on your appliances, their running and starting loads, and the hours of backup you need. Share a recent electricity bill and an appliance list to start the conversation.

Do you help with electrical compliance?+

Electrical compliance inspections are one of the listed services. An inspection determines whether remedial work is needed before a certificate can be issued.
